title: Simulated Input
instructions: Why do these playground exercises use sample values stored in variables instead of `readLine()`?

options.text: The playground cannot pause for interactive console input, so variables stand in for incoming values
Variables are slower but more accurate
readLine() only works with numbers, not strings

explanation: The playground cannot pause and wait for interactive console input. A sample variable lets you practice processing a value that could later come from a person, sensor, controller, or function parameter.
